_note: Retrieval settings for scripts/update_publications.py. Besides the ORCID, the updater reads works of verifiedOpenAlexAuthorIds (every work of these records is the PI's) and, when autoMatch is true, accepts Iowa State papers naming the PI on any other record after a per-paper check (see auto_match and README.md). excludeAuthorIds blocks a record from auto-match entirely. doNotTrust lists records that must never be trusted wholesale; their papers can still pass the per-paper check.
